notes.title: Patch Notes: Easter + Fog of War Edition 18/4/25
notes.content:
Happy Good Friday!

We're very excited to announce a special new Easter World, which is also going to introduce an experimental new gameplay feature - Fog of War!

7 minutes ago

[h1]Easter World[/h1]
Explore EDYN in a completely new way!

Peel back the shroud to discover friend and foe... 

...and eggs.

The Scuttlers are keen to keep the chocolatey goodness for themselves, but if you can wrest these sugary settlements from their grimy paws, you'll be rewarded with sweet new customisation appearances for you characters!

[h1]Fog of War[/h1]
The FoW adds a completely new feel to the World Map. Restricted vision makes the relationship with your neighbours much more intimate. Capturing settlements becomes far more strategic, and friendships/alliances become substantially more valuable.

[list]
[*] Every settlement starts with a small amount of initial vision
[*] You cannot send any missions outside of your vision range
[*] You can increase your vision by upgrading your Watch Tower to L12 and L30
[*] Vision can be shared by adding friends
[*] Vision can also be shared by joining an Alliance
[*] A new graphic indicator now shows your detection radius for incoming attacks
[*] 
[/list]

[h1]Shop Update: Easter Pass[/h1]
This will be added with a hotfix soon.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Optimisation Edition 11/4/25
notes.content:
Evening @announcements,

Some really good news today for folks that have been struggling with loading times. We realised that the scene loading times needed improvement months ago, and have been actively working behind the scenes to do everything in our power to bring this right down to 0-1 seconds. With today's build, at least for the World and Settlement scenes, we believe we've pretty much got it there. On the team's intermediate test rig, we are able to jump between all of the faction's settlement scenes, and the world map within a single second loading time. The war rooms are much faster too, most are down from 4 seconds to around 2 now as well. We will continue to work on this as an ongoing process.

We are also in the process of updating to Unity 6, which will also bring further improvements and a nice little boost to visual fidelity too. We hope to accomplish this within the next couple of weeks. 

[b]Rat Logic #3 Opening in 4 minutes[/b]

The next world in our rotation is Rat Logic 3! For this update we've been tinkering with the Scuttler's AI, they've been learning from player data from previous worlds... their behaviour may be different. Watch out!

[b]General & Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] From feedback: Token cost in research does not carry over to different factions. Only the gold charge does now
[*] Fixed research cost not scaling correctly for tokens
[*] Speed World pace restored to x15 (up from x12.5)
[*] Speed World recruitment speed reduced by 50%
[*] Fixed pixilated graphics/icons and broken upgrade animation
[*] Fixed coloniser recruitment time exceeding the maximum threshold
[*] Fixed unit power preview being incorrect in the war room and army overview
[*] Fixed incoming raids would display an alert report before an incoming mission warning was displayed
[/list]

notes.title: Research Centre Update + Speed World #7 Launch
notes.content:
Research Centre Update + Speed World #7 LIVE NOW!

Alongside our Research update, we'll be launching our next Speed World where cosmetic victory crowns will be awarded to the top 3 players!

Research Overhaul

Visit any Research building and behold the marvellous and compellingly named "RESEARCH" page. Here you will find a new research tree that will unleash powerful and GLOBAL effects to all of your settlements and armies.

Time To Cash In!

Finally you can exchange those Grisly Tokens you've been hording for reasons that are, well, frankly dubious and quite grim really, but here we are.

In exchange for Tokens (and a small donation of your general currency), you will be able to purchase Nodes from the Research Tree in the relevant 'flavour' of the Faction that you've been pulverising the most. As you work down the Research Branches, you will discover increasingly powerful nodes and effects. 

Be advised, each Node purchase will increase the cost of the next. So it would be wise to plan ahead and determine which Faction(s) are likely going to be your biggest adversaries for the current game.

Also you can't Research your own Faction. Weirdos.

Milestones And The Rest

The experience from enduring (or inflicting) relentless savagery from countless battles is channelled down into your armies!  As you purchase more and more Nodes, you will level up through 6 'Milestones'. Each Milestone allows you to recruit promoted units right out of the gates! 

Initial Nodes are immediately available when building the Research Centre, however in order to progress deeper into the Research Branches, you will need to level up the building and unlock the perks via our traditional system every 6 levels.

You can research one Node at a time per Settlement and you can research additional Nodes if you have idle Research Centres across different settlements. Levelling up the Research Centre increases the speed of research.

We plan to add several more Nodes in the near future. We're just getting started!

Enjoy, experiment and go wild with this new update!

notes.title: Patch Notes - 28/3/25
notes.content:
Big one today. This might not seem like the most exciting update, but it's nonetheless a vital one. When we first went live in November, one of the biggest aspects we wanted to test for was the responsiveness of our servers, especially in regards to handling hundreds of concurrent players, with thousands, sometimes even tens of thousands of simultaneous missions active. What we found was that when armies started reaching the millions of units, in extreme cases, some battles started to take up to a minute to calculate. Even sending large forces could lead to several seconds of delay.

We've been doing lots of fixes and patches to improve our systems over the last few months, but we ultimately we needed to redesign the underlying architecture to not only fix the issue, but ensure that we can achieve our ambition of having the potential to host hundreds, if not, thousands of players.

From today we want to test this new architecture for the first time in a special experimental Flurry World. 

[h1]Flurry World #2 Launch[/h1]

Stress test the game edition!

Here it is, we're hoping this will be the ultimate test to see how our servers can cope with virtually unlimited armies. All units will recruit 100x faster (colo units still have 30+ min increments), and we've doubled the infantry resource generation to help get things moving!

We are testing running this World at 12.5x, which is approximately 20% slower than the previous event modes. For clarification, we've been running the events at 15x, so this new Flurry World is set at 12.5x, which is halfway between the OG Speed World (10x) and KOTH #2. 

Your feedback is important and helps us tune the game for your enjoyment. Please let us know in #feedback or #general how you feel about the gameplay. If we've found the sweet spot - great! If you preferred it faster, or somewhere in-between, please let us know!

[b]Known issues:[/b]

[list]
[*] This is a highly experimental mode, please bear with us as we're certain things will break. Keep us posted in #bugs!
[*] Unit healing and unit XP are disabled. We will be hotfixing these back in ASAP.
[*] Scuttlers will not send raids.
[/list]

[h1]World #3 Launch[/h1]

We have taken onboard feedback from World 2 and have made the following pacing and colonisation improvements:

[list]
[*] This World is set at 1.2x speed (20% faster than World 2).
[*] Your first colo unit will now take 6 hours (down from 12) and each increment will be 6 hours (down from 12).
[*] New: We've introduced a new limit on the maximum possible time it can take to recruit colonise units (48 hours).
[/list]

[h1]World #2 Closing Soon + Reward Hoodies![/h1]

It seems the World itself has been kneaded into soft dough beneath the unyielding hands of the CrazyCookieCroc. A subtle scent of ginger lingers on the breeze as the sun dips below the horizon, casting its golden light over a sprawling Kingdom now blanketed in frosting and adorned with gleaming gumdrop buttons. No soul could resist the intoxicating allure of such sweetness, and in the annals of history, this day shall forever be remembered.

Well done to the top 3 who will be eligible for custom hoodies. We'll be able to get these arranged much faster than the previous batch.

CrazyCookieCroc
Lorilynn
Loirise

Hoodies from World #1 have been added with today's patch. We hope you enjoy!

AnubisScar
Bentros
Loirise

[h1]KOTH #2 Closing Soon![/h1]

Special shout out to our returning King Gaunt, it's looking like he's going to keep his title! Thanks for being such a good sport, and going out of your way to put forward great feedback and suggestions to help us improve the game. Same goes to Lorilynn and LichLordAnubis!

[h1]General & Fixes[/h1]

We've introduced a cap to our recruitment duration increments for colonise units that can be tuned per World. These have been set to 48 and 5 hours for Classic and Speed Worlds respectively (assuming Factory is max level). This simply means that recruitment times will never exceed these thresholds, regardless of how many colonise units are recruited.

[list]
[*] Leaderboards updated
[*] Fixed missing scroll bar from settlement dropdown
[*] Fixed reported typos
[*] Fixed Mech Croc and Bone Jackal mesh display issues during the character creation process
[*] Fixed a number of message centre bugs (please keep us informed about on-going message anomalies - they can be difficult to reproduce! We are working on offline notifications.)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 28/2/25
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Sorry for the delay this evening, we caught some last minute bugs during QA so decided to hold off for a couple of hours and fix, rather that delay a great new feature!

[h1]Massive Character Customisation Update![/h1]
Part two of our character creation overhaul process is now live. In total we've added over 100 new customisation options and will continue to add more as time goes by! We've further refined the UI to be more responsive and added a function that let's you unlock new appearances for XP. Additional appearances will soon be linked to certain achievements, and some more eccentric designs will be found in the shop in future.

Important: All accounts will start with a default appearance, and all other options will have an XP cost associated. This means that some of the appearances that were previously free now have a cost. To compensate for this, for this week only we have set the cost of the previously free appearances to be majorly discounted, so we'd suggest to snag these now so they are permanently unlocked to your account. The Krok's Mech skin will be quite expensive for example next week!

[h1]Global Mission Toggle[/h1]
Above the scroll bar you'll find a new toggle. Clicking this will switch between displaying missions related to your local/active settlement to displaying missions related to all of your settlements. Your mission list overlay will be combined, and the best part is on the World Map you will now see mission banners moving to and from all settlements under your control. It's seriously cool - footage below!

Incoming delivery missions will now also display the resource count.

[h1]Rat Logic #2[/h1]
Starting in 32 minutes at 28 February 2025 at 20:00

Using everything we've learned from observing the Scuttlers and listening to community feedback, our ratty friends are going turbo again, and this time... You Will Die!

We've removed the usual safeguards and boosted some numbers, let's see how you all get on! We suggest you use your time wisely and fortify your positions, because by next Friday morning, the Scuttlers will be going into berserk mode. Be ready!

notes.title: Patch Notes: 21/2/25
notes.content:
At last! Our new game mode - King of the Hill!

We've been working on this for quite some time and are very excited to see how this will affect the gameplay experience! During our in-house testing, we found this to really exceed our expectations - it's seriously fun, and opens up a lot of interesting new strategic opportunities. We hope you enjoy!

Alongside this new game mode, we've incorporated a number community suggested features and squashed several bugs!

We're still in the process of adding dozens of new XP unlockable appearances to our updated character creation process, that's coming together nicely and should be ready next week.

[h1]Edyn's King of the Hill![/h1]
Starting soon: in 22 minutes at 21 February 2025 at 18:00

Score is gained only by capturing and then holding one of the 8 monolithic Shard objectives.

Shard holders will gain a single point per minute, and can gain multiple points for holding multiple shards.

Each time a Shard is captured it will grant the holder a random powerful global buff (affecting all settlements) which will be displayed on the new leaderboard.

You cannot build structures or train units on any of the shards. However, you can send reinforcements and guards to try and fortify your position.

Defending a shard is very difficult, the territory comes with a major defensive disadvantage in combat. They will exchange hands often.

The colonise unit time increment penalty has been removed as you'll need to burn through many colony units in order to control the Shards in this mode.

[b]Rewards:[/b]
A new time limited title "King" (or "Queen" if requested!) will be bestowed to the player that finishes in first position. Note: We will likely be running KOTH monthly, so the title will pass over to to the next monarch that finished in top position and so on. If the title holder joins the subsequent KOTH game, we're planning to give them a special advantage at the beginning of the game!

The usual currency rewards will be in place for the top 10 positions.

[h1]Gameplay & Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now preview all items before purchasing any pass sold by Skeev.
[*] 'INCOMING' missions now display their settlement origin instead of destination coordinates.
[*] 'INCOMING' supportive/friendly missions now display what units or resources are contained.
[*] Mission speed is recalculated after battle, if slower units die, the mission return speed will be faster. Units displayed in the mission container will be updated to reflect.
[*] Mission banners now display a timer on the world map.
[*] If you are already building a colonise unit on a different settlement, the notice will inform where.
[*] Several minor UI tweaks and improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Notes
notes.content:
Happy Valentine's Day folks!

To celebrate we're opening a fun little experimental event World (details below) and a themed pass. A quick reminder that Speed World #5 will be simultaneously ending as the new World begins, the final top 10 will then be snapshotted and awards announced on our Discord!

[h2]Valentine's World[/h2]

Starts 6pm GMT (UK time).

Watch out denizens of EDYN!! With the love of Valentine's in the air, the Scuttlers are getting... a little [i]animated[/i] let's say. Aggression is sky rocketing. There's only one way to survive: There's safety in numbers! Form Alliances and then [b]buy[/b] the Scuttlers' affection.

[h3] Here's the rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scuttler safeguards are removed. They will attack even if your score is lower than theirs.
[*] The Scutters will train more units, build more frequently and send bigger attacks.
[*] They will go for easy targets. Players not in Alliances will be obliterated.
[*] There's no "I" in team! Only Alliances are ranked in this mode.
[*] The only way to achieve score is to [b]FEED THE RATS[/b]! Send resource delivery missions to any Scuttler settlement to earn 'affection points'. Be generous!
[*] The [i]higher[/i] % your Alliance's 'Scuttler Affection' is, the [i]less[/i] likely the Scuttlers will raid you.
[/list]
[h3]Rewards:[/h3]

[b]Everybody[/b] in the top Alliance will receive the title "Rat Lover".

[b]Everybody[/b] in the top 5 Alliances will receive a new Valentine's flavoured appearance for the faction that they are currently playing as when the event closes on the 21st at 6pm GMT (UK time). 

The Valentine's appearances will then be added to Skeev's shop and available for everyone to buy for a limited time in exchange for our premium Shard currency.

 [h2]Character Creation & In-Game Edit Visual Update[/h2]

We've completed a major visual facelift for the entire character creation process. Everything including faction selection, character creation, and the freedom to edit again in-game. The UI has been overhauled to be more intuitive, look much nicer, and is the first of two updates for character customisation in general.

Coming soon, we'll be expanding the character customisation library massively, and you'll be able to utilise all of your hard earned XP points to unlock more options! 

[h3] Shop Preview Function[/h3]

For the current event pass and any future listed items, you will be given an extra step where you can preview your character wearing the item. If your current character doesn't match the faction's item type then you will be shown a default faction member showcasing the item.

[h2]General & Fixes[/h2]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 31/1/25
notes.content:
This week we've been very focused on preparing our backend systems for a special event (planned for the 7th) and the incoming major Research Centre update. Today we're rolling out the first part of that system alongside Classic World 2 in order to ensure that players will be able to fully take advantage of that new gameplay feature as soon as it is released in the very near future.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[h2]Grisly Tokens[/h2]
Killing or wounding most enemy unit types during battle will now award an additional resource. These are granted to both the attacker and defender. These gruesome trophies are instantly stored at the character level (not like typical resources at the settlement level) and can soon be exchanged at any of your Research Centres to carry out studies that will bestow powerful global upgrades on all settlements and armies under your rule. There's one caveat: The factions of EDYN will not take trophies from their own kind! You can track how many you've earned by accessing the new page inside the Research Centre.

[h2]World Switching Feature[/h2]
Many of our players expressed the desire for more convenient switching between different active Worlds. Typically when we have an active event, players like to focus on the faster paced event, but also have an active session on the slower classic style world in the background that they want to be able to quickly jump in and out of at the same time. We've added a World Selection menu to the pause screen that now facilitates this ability.

[h2]General and Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] We've done further optimisation on the world Map. It loads nearly twice as fast now.
[*] Optimisation has been done to all of the Settlement scenes. These are loading about 10 - 20% faster but we will be getting these a lot faster soon too.
[*] All of the War Rooms have also had minor to moderate optimisation.
[*] New formula for looted resources to make the distribution a little more even.
[*] Several of the UIs have been refined and had improved placements/padding.
[*] Fixed several issues relating to the new rat AI.
[*] Fixed a display bug that would cause flickering of certain UIs on 4K resolution.
[*] Fixed incorrect settlement display formatting when visiting external settlements.
[*] Fixed resources displaying the placeholder '000K' after visiting external settlements.
[/list]

[h2]Ending Imminently: Rat Logic! & Classic World #1[/h2]

The usual placement rewards will be issued at 31 January 2025 at 19:00 for the top 10 players of Rat Logic!

We're really happy with the Scuttler's new sentience and will be incorporating the logic into all future World types, with some of the behaviour toned down. We will continue to build on their intelligence as time goes on, and the Rat Logic! event will return in future with improvements and exaggerated AI.

The next weekly style event world will be the following Friday the 7th. We're cooking up another experimental game mode for EDYN that rhymes with "Sing of the Will".

[h2]Classic World #1[/h2]

We want to make sure that the players who commit to the long campaigns of our traditional worlds feel like their commitment is graciously rewarded and we've got some exciting ideas in mind to that effect - I'll be reaching out to the top 3 players to discuss next week.

In the meantime we'll be issuing the currency rewards for placements at 10x our standard rate. AnubisScar and Brentos will 100% be getting 'The Insane' title for their phenomenal performance.

notes.title: Update Note for 17 Jan 2025
notes.content:
Happy Friday all!

We've just pushed this week's update so please ensure you get that installed in time before trying to join the incoming experimental Flurry World.

We've been pretty ambitious and squeezed in a lot of major gameplay reforms so please bear with us if anything misbehaves in game, we'll be watching feedback carefully for bug reports and also listening in on the general consensus for how the game feels with all of the new systems.

The faster paced Flurry World will start on 17 January 2025 at 18:00 GMT.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[h2]New Army Overview Overlay[/h2]
This handy little collapsible overlay is a mirrored counterpart to the active mission list. It will display all units currently stationed at the settlement that are not currently on a mission. In addition, this new overlay has tabs that will let you see units that have been transferred or even garrisoned from external locations.

[h2]Initial Settlement Protection[/h2]
[list]
[*] Your initial settlement cannot be captured until you've acquired four additional settlements of your own (5 total).
[*] Does not protect from raids or siege damage, however colonise units will always fail.
[*] There is a new graphic to show protected settlements on the World Map.
[*] You will be given a notice that the protection will end if you successfully take your fifth settlement.
[*] Beware - once the protection ends it will not come back, making you vulnerable to being defeated!
[*] We've added an additional graphic to show our previously implemented 'Beginner Protection' which will still automatically be removed after 12 hours.
[/list]
[h2]Combat Score[/h2]
The leaderboard has been updated so that you can now hover over a player's score to see the breakdown. We want the combat score to be more supplementary towards the overall score instead of the primary driver. Destroying (not wounding) enemy units in combat will grant points to the defender or attacker. Siege damage will also grant a small number of points, but this is going to be a much lower ratio in relation to the building's diminished point value. We don't want to encourage people to feel like they are being forced to wantonly destroy buildings in order to be competitive on the leaderboard, nor risk people exploiting the mechanic. Combat score is not awarded for faction infighting.
[h2]Duality by Default[/h2]
As part of the experimental settings being used for the Flurry World, the Barracks will now start with the ability to recruit two unit types at once and unlock all four at level 30. We want to see how this affects gameplay in conjunction with the slower settlement scaling. If this change is positively received, we will explore making this baseline for all future World types.
[h2]Global Coloniser Recruitment Queue[/h2]
Coloniser units now can only be trained once at a time at the global level. For the Flurry World each subsequent order will increase the increment by 30 mins (we expect this to be around 12 hours for the next Classic World). This increment will be refunded if one of your settlements is captured. The team are very excited to see the results of all of these changes combined as we expect them to dramatically change the scaling and general chemistry of the game for the better. We will continue to watch closely, building on top of these systems and tuning accordingly.
[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] New display logic on unit cards for speed. The number now indicates how many tiles can be crossed per hour.
[*] For now only defeated players can delete their characters. This system will be reworked in the near future.
[*] If all units are lost in battle the pop up report now displays "?" instead of reporting the rival army numbers.
[*] The mission list and new army overlays now instantly refresh when changing between settlements.
[*] Skeev is no longer feeling festive but is very much looking forward to Valentine's.
[*] The number display format is now nicely standardised throughout the game.
[*] The World Map seems different.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Barrack/Factory recruitment overlay to freeze when ordering units from the other building.
[*] Fixed issue where lighting from the shop would be baked into the previous scene on exit.
[*] Fixed Beginner Protection expiring early due to interactions with Scuttlers (bad rats!).
[*] Fixed unit experience bars failing to update from the default values.
[*] Fixed units in combat failing to display their initial health pool.
[*] Fixed a typo in the pop up reports "Remaining" is now "Lost".
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 10/1/25
notes.content:
Our first big update for 2025 is driven almost exclusively by community feedback! Thank you to everybody that's been contributing feedback and suggestions. We've finished our internal Q1 roadmap and plan to share that with the community next week. We've got tons of new features and improvements scheduled for the next couple of months, plus events and marketing planned to start sharing EDYN to a much wider audience.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]

[list]
[*] Wall chip damage has now been implemented. The attacker's combat margin will now influencer how much siege structure damage will be inflicted. If the battle is won the total siege damage will proportional to the attacker combat % margin. Stronger victory = more destruction. Attackers that are defeated can now inflict structure damage - this is calculated at a lower ratio (combat % margin / 2).
[*] We've added an interactive graphic to the Factory and Barracks that lets you see your recruitment progress. You can also hover over these to see your queue progress and order backlog.
[*] The Report Centre has been updated and now Guard, Transfer and Deliver missions all have summary pop-ups that lets you see how many units and resources have changed hands. This works for both sender and receiver.
[*] The Raid mission summary pop-up now includes spoils to save having to open the full report every time.
[*] All mission summaries now have animations to increase the visual appeal of the results!
[*] (Backend) We've now got Speed Worlds and Classic Worlds being control by two different control panels. This will allow us to tune both modes independently to enrich the gameplay of both, and also try more fun experimental settings outside of "go slower or go faster". We'll be doing a PTR for Classic World #2 soon using these new values.
[/list]

[h1]General + Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Changing settlement now instantly refreshes the resource display instead of waiting for the next tick.
[*] Increased the texture and fur render quality of all War Rooms and most characters.
[*] Fixed a character creation issue which resulted in the first appearance option being impossible to select.
[*] Fixed "Set Active" settlement shortcut button in the World Map.
[*] Fixed Numanz building deploy radial missing certain elements from the thumbnails.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing 'Defeated' players from being able to log in to their characters... we like hardcore PvP but that was a bit much!
[*] Fixed very rare occurrences of battles ending 50 - 50. On such occasions the defender will now be rounded to a victory 51 - 49.
[/list]

[h1]Know Issues[/h1]

[list]
[*] Unit health bars in reports always indicate that they started combat as full health, even if wounded. The backend calculation is still being carried out correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 12/12/24
notes.content:
We're releasing the patch a day early as we've made a number of fixes that we want to deploy ASAP. We've been busy this week working on mostly backend systems related to beginner protection, healing and incoming quest/XP mechanics.

[b]Gameplay[/b]

Beginner protection will now be applied to newly registered players on all worlds. This protection will last for 24 hours on Classic Worlds and 12 hours on Speed Worlds. Going forward, we can easily tune these numbers subject to player feedback. Players under beginner protection cannot be the target of any mission types during this window. The protected player can freely raid Scuttlers, but cannot send missions to other players unless they want to exit protection early. If the protected player wishes to opt out, they can target an external player with a mission at which point they will be prompted with a confirmation to end beginner protection early. We'll be looking into adding some kind of visual indicator for beginner protection soon.

Fortune is a system that's been active in the background and is now linked into the battle reports alongside the new Research building functionality. Fortune is a -15% to +15% random swing that will boost or diminish combat efficacy for the attacking army only. Your 'Tech Level' is combined with this value. We have some other exciting systems in development that will further synergise with this.

Healing is now live! Effective immediately for all Worlds, all damaged units (except Vanguard) will now gradually restore lost hit points. Currently we've set this to be approximately 10% of their total health per day for Classic Worlds. We'll be watching and tuning this very carefully over the coming days to make sure it feels balanced. This healing rate will be increased to 10x for Speed Worlds. 'Boost healing' that will burn resources is WIP but will require more time as it needs UI adaptations.

[list]
[*] Units will only heal while 'resting'. A unit is considered to be resting while not assigned any mission. Guards posted at an external destination are on an active mission therefore are not resting.
[*] While selecting units to be sent on a mission, the game will pick the units with the most health first. So consider selecting smaller increments for battle if you want your wounded to rest up.
[*] Resting units that are sent on missions will have their healing timer reset so be mindful of their healing tick intervals:
[/list]

Melee - 1 tick per 12h.
Ranged - 1 tick per 24h.
AoE - 1 tick per 24h.
Siege - 1 tick per 3h.
Coloniser - 1 tick per 3h.


[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Skeev is feeling even more festive.
[*] The world select UI has had a complete design overhaul.
[*] Improved the visual responsiveness of settlement nameplates, the World Map should load slightly faster as a result.
[*] Improved settlement spawning logic to improve Scuttler positions in relationship to new players.
[*] Fixed Alliance chat history failing to load, and several other message centre discrepancies (please let us know if you spot more, these can be very tricky to reproduce!)
[*] Fixed several issues with character customisation preferences failing to load in the War Room and Diplomacy scenes.
[*] Fixed Vanguard recruitment perk failing to activate at Barracks level 6.
[*] Fixed incorrectly generous recruitment scaling granted by Barracks and Factory on Classic Worlds.
[*] Fixed an issue with building nameplates intersecting into scaffolding for some factions.
[*] Fixed a nameplate double layering issue causing them to appear darker than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing nameplate animations (such as the upgrade arrow + timers) to distort.
[*] Fixed "Accept frienf invitation" spelling - sorry frienfs!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 6/12/24
notes.content:
Hi all,

We've just pushed a big update ahead of the launch of Speed World #3 and Classic World #1. Please ensure that you update your game before trying to play. Both new Worlds will be deployed within the next hour at 6pm GMT/UK time (converted to your local time here -> 6 December 2024 at 18:00).

For reference, all of our Worlds to date have been Speed Worlds, including Thor's World event. They run x10 faster than Classic. If you've loved the fast paced competitive landscape of the previous Worlds, then expect nothing short of the same, with all of the latest gameplay improvements and tighter numbers. If you've found in the past that the time commitment was a bit overwhelming, or you simply like the idea of engaging with slower burning World and its denizens over a period of weeks and months, then please consider signing up to our very first Classic World - my personal favourite version of EDYN!

[b]Mac Support Added[/b]
We've been testing a Mac build of EDYN in-house throughout the week and we're happy that it's stable enough for us to deploy. Mac users can now download and play on Steam. We'll update the store page with the system specs we've tested on. Please let us know how you get on.

[b]Skeev's Shop Open For Business![/b]
We're testing out Skeev's shop with a couple of basic items for now, and enabling the purchase of EDYN's cosmetic exchange currency "Shards", a reference to the fragments of EDYN's meteorite found strewed across the land. Skeev bestows great value on these Shards and will trade cool cosmetic only goodies in return. We plan to use Skeev's shop as a hub for our incoming quest system and also be a placed where ranked rewards can be found. More info coming soon!

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Research building v0.5 is now live. The Research building was always intended to be utilised as an end game resource burning option, we've now just implemented the first step of its functionality. As the Research building is upgraded, it will increase the colony's "Tech Level" by 0.3%. The Tech Level is applied to attacking forces only. The unique trait of this building is that you can continue to upgrade it beyond level 30. The Tech Level will continue to scale indefinitely. With Research v1.0 that we are working on, it will add a talent tree style system where you will be able to purchase nodes to apply powerful global effects all of your armies and colonies.
[*] If all units die in a raid, a report is not generated for the defeated army - nobody has survived to tell the tale!
[*] Barrack/Factory perk updates - Both buildings now have a new level 30 perk that will unlock the ability to train two unit different unit types at once.
[*] We've relaxed the Colony unit's recruitment increment from +1 hour to +45 minutes per order (not applicable to Classic Worlds).
[*] Resource numbers and building costs have been tuned to ensure a smoother overall levelling experience and should result in less wasted overflow at max level/end game.
[/list]

[b]Visual Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now preview all of the incoming and previously unlocked building perks from the building upgrade UI. Tooltips have been added to explain their function (We're in the process of adding tooltips literally everywhere!).
[*] We've added a new radial variation for selecting colonies that are controlled by the player. This allows you to "Set Active" a colony, which is a shortcut and the equivalent of using the drop down menu from the top of the UI.
[*] We've refined and expanded the drop down list that displays your colonies. You can more many more now and see additional information.
[*] Your Alliance banner is now displayed above your colony nameplate.
[/list]

[b]General and Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] We've done an optimisation pass that has mainly targeted textures bringing down the entire install size by 30%~. This has made an improvement to memory size and loading times. We will be doing a lot more to improve the speed of the scene loading times. This is a top priority for us now.
[*] Players will need to have the latest version of the game to join a World.
[*] A new font has been added to increase text legibility
[*] Mission tab now hides when inspecting a building.
[*] Mission counter refreshes faster now.
[*] Fixed an issue with settings preferences failing to carry over to the next application launch.
[*] Fixed text and scale alignment issues in both the upgrade and recruitment building UIs
[*] Fixed a bug in the War Room that would fail to update the mission type to 'Transfer' from 'Guard' if the player changed the origin colony via the drop down menu.
[*] Fixed several frontend display errors in the battle reports. Notably the Siege unit failing to show its health adjustment during combat.
[*] Fixed Message Centre loading/latency issue. Should be super snappy now.
[*] Fixed an animation glitch related to a building upgrade being completed while not in focus.
[*] Fixed an issue with reports not being generated during a colony capture.
[*] Fixed several shader and texture issues related to buildings and character props. Also resolved the low quality texture problem of the Jackal skins.
[*] Fixed several building nameplate scale inconsistencies.
[*] Fixed 'instance of reference not found' error.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*] The Mech Croc cannot equip and body/head slots currently. Working on a fix ASAP.
[/list]

notes.title: Thor’s World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277669/6c3609ae0f9aa1bc395538a31176b1fabd4cffd0.png[/img]

[h1]Gear up, Conquerors of EDYN![/h1]

The Thor’s World event has arrived, and it’s destined to be legendary!

[h2]Here’s what you can expect[/h2]

[h3]Claim the Exclusive 'Pirate' Title[/h3]
Create your character on Thor’s World and permanently unlock the “Pirate” title—a rare and prestigious prefix that travels with you across all worlds, forever!

[h3]RAID Boss Madness [/h3]
Join the fight to take down 63 MAX-LEVEL RAID BOSSES to restore order to this fractured world!

[h3]Defend or Destroy: [/h3]
Will you reinforce the raid bosses to delay your rivals, or seize the opportunity to bring them down? Each boss must be captured on the world map before the chaos subsides—but strategy is key. Reinforce to buy time, or strike to claim glory.

[h3]One Shall Rise! [/h3]
Only ONE player will walk away with the legendary title of 'Ferret Lord'—awarded to the conqueror with the most captured boss bases. A title for eternity.

Starting November 29th at 15:00 GMT, the event will end when all the Ferret Bosses are defeated.

**UPDATE**

A massive congratulations to our newly coronated Ferret King ZeOwl, and his freshly elected and esteemed Ferret Lords: 

Final placements were as follows:

We hope everyone enjoyed taking part in our very first event mode. The team at EDYN loved watching the progress and politics over the last week! 
We plan to have many more events in future and plan to get really creative with some of the themes and rewards. We've learned a ton from hosting this!

Once again, thanks to all of the players that took part and for being great sports.

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 29
notes.content:
Patch notes released a little early today as we have a bit of a surprise event planned in the next couple of hours. Details will be posted very soon.

[b]General[/b]

[list]
[*] Skeev is feeling festive.
[*] Improved responsiveness of the double-click to upgrade function, improved visuals and you should now feel a nice burst of dopamine when you see a building complete its upgrade process.
[*] The active mission counters will now persist when the mission tab is collapsed for improved tracking. Also fixed a scale and alignment issue with the list itself.
[*] Increased the font size and added further visual polish for all unit recruitment.
[*] Fixed a latency issue when making massive recruitment orders.
[*] Increased the scale of the world map and settlement buttons.
[/list]
[b]Message Centre[/b]

[list]
[*] Chat overlay icon will now glow when new world + faction messages are posted while hidden.
[*] Notification icons will now appear over the message centre for friend requests, Alliance invites, Alliance messages and Diplomacy events.
[*] User uploaded banners for Alliances are now fully working.
[*] You will get a confirmation prompt before being able to exit the Alliance via the profile.
[*] Fixed messages being duplicated when sent in diplomacy mode.
[*] Fixed display issue where Alliance messages would be carried over into the chat overlay.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list]
[*] We've done a visual overhaul to the battle reports to improve presentation and legibility. We've done further tuning to our combat calculations to more closely align with our Rock-Paper-Scissors vison. The unit's power (its blue number) is dynamically adjusted into a 'combat rating' during battle in relation to how proportionately it counters or is countered by the other army as a whole. The green number; the hit points are adjusted accordingly.
[*] Step right up! We're implemented the first part of the unit queue system. This will restrict the Barracks and Factory to being able to recruit one unit type at at time. We've been listening to feedback about the army system being more of a sheer number game, so we're aiming to make recruitment a lot more strategic. Training too many of one unit can now leave you open to being countered by another. We are trialling this, and if popular we can expand it to allow additional unit types to be queued but only sequentially.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Espionage success rate being calculated incorrectly. Upgrading the Watch Tower will now correctly apply an increasingly moderate boost to your Espionage mission odds, whilst also slightly reducing the odds of your enemies.
[/list]
